raw_note:
Complete HP Primitive Line Mapping:

Q7-Q13: Dual N-MOSFETs (SOT-23-6, marking 'DS01')
  Pinout: Pin 2/5=common drain (D12), Pins 4/6=sources (S1,S2), Pins 1/3=gates (G1,G2)
  Common drain (pin 2/5) → VDD (~12V)
  Sources (pin 4/6) → HP lines to cartridge
  Gates (pin 1/3) → CM504B outputs

IC1 (CM504B) - HP00-HP05:
  HP00: GPA0 (SoC pin 79) → IC1.AIN→AOUT → Q7.G1 → HP00
  HP01: GPA1 (SoC pin 78) → IC1.BIN→BOUT → Q7.G2 → HP01
  HP02: GPA4 (SoC pin 75) → IC1.CIN→COUT → Q8.G1 → HP02
  HP03: GPA2 (SoC pin 77) → IC1.DIN→DOUT → Q8.G2 → HP03
  HP04: [TBD]            → IC1.EIN→EOUT → Q9.G1 → HP04
  HP05: GPA5 (SoC pin 74) → IC1.FIN→FOUT → Q9.G2 → HP05
  Reserve: GPA3 (SoC pin 76) → IC1.DIN (data line, exact function TBD)

IC2 (CM504B) - HP06-HP11:
  HP06: GPA6 (SoC pin 73)  → IC2.AIN→AOUT → Q10.G1 → HP06
  HP07: GPA7 (SoC pin 103) → IC2.BIN→BOUT → Q10.G2 → HP07
  HP08: GPD5 (SoC pin 113) → IC2.CIN→COUT → Q11.G1 → HP08
  HP09: GPA11/GPA10 (SoC pin 123/122) → IC2.DIN→DOUT → Q11.G2 → HP09
  HP10: GPA7 (SoC pin 103) → IC2.EIN→EOUT → Q12.G1 → HP10
  HP11: GPD6 (SoC pin 112) → IC2.FIN→FOUT → Q12.G2 → HP11

IC6 (CM504B) - HP12-HP13 (shared with HA18-HA21):
  HP12: GPD7 (SoC pin 115) → IC6.EIN→EOUT → Q13.G1 → HP12
  HP13: GPD8 (SoC pin 114) → IC6.FIN→FOUT → Q13.G2 → HP13

Key Points:
- HP lines carry actual heating current (~0.3-0.4A per active nozzle)
- High-side MOSFETs switch VDD to HP lines when gates are driven high
- Multiple HP lines can be active simultaneously (respecting current limits)
- Firmware should configure GPA0-7, GPA10-11, GPD5-8 as outputs
- Each HP line connects to 22 nozzles (one per HA address)

Note: Some pin assignments (HP04, HP07/HP10 overlap, HP09 exact pin) require verification against actual firmware GPIO patterns.
summary: The 14 HP45 primitive lines (HP0-HP13) control which nozzles fire within the selected HA address. Each HP line is driven by a dual N-MOSFET (Q7-Q13, marking 'DS01') configured as high-side switches with common drain at VDD (~12V). Gates are driven by three CM504B level shifters (IC1, IC2, IC6) from SoC pins GPA0-GPA11, GPD5-GPD8. Multiple HP lines can be active simultaneously to fire multiple nozzles in parallel.
title: HP45 Primitive Lines (HP0-HP13) - Pin Mapping and High-Side MOSFET Drivers
